_comment: Generic fallback config for any local service business not covered by a specific industry file.
rsa_guidance: Emphasize licensed and insured, local expertise, upfront pricing, fast response, and years in business. Use the service name and city prominently. Focus on trust and credentials as the primary conversion levers.

city.heading: Why Choose a Local Professional?
city.intro: Local licensed professionals bring expertise, accountability, and community trust that national chains can't match. When something goes wrong, you need someone who shows up fast and stands behind their work.
bullets: Local knowledge: we understand the specific conditions and codes in your area
Fast response: no dispatch centers — we're nearby and can respond the same day
Accountability: local businesses live and work in your community
Warranty: we stand behind our work long after the job is done

cost.heading: What Does {service} Cost?
cost.intro: Every job is different — cost depends on the scope of work, materials required, and access. We provide a written upfront quote before any work starts so you know exactly what to expect.
bullets: Scope: larger or more complex jobs take more time and materials
Access: hard-to-reach areas may require additional labor
Materials: we use quality materials that last — we'll explain the options
No hidden fees: the price you're quoted is the price you pay
cost.callout: We provide a written upfront estimate before any work begins. No surprises.

company.heading: Why Choose Us?
company.intro: Here's what sets us apart from the competition.
bullets: Licensed & Insured: fully licensed and insured for your protection
Local & Experienced: we've served this community for years
Upfront Pricing: you know the cost before we start — no surprise invoices
Satisfaction Guaranteed: we stand behind our work

free-estimate.heading: What Happens During a Free Estimate?
free-estimate.intro: Our free assessment is a no-obligation, on-site evaluation. You'll know exactly what the job involves and what it will cost before committing to anything.
bullets: We assess the full scope of the job on-site
We explain all options and their trade-offs
We provide a written quote — no pressure, no obligation
You decide when and whether to move forward
free-estimate.callout: The estimate is completely free. No obligation to proceed.

insurance.heading: Does Insurance Cover This Work?
insurance.intro: Coverage depends on your specific policy and the nature of the work. We can provide documentation to support your claim.
bullets: We provide photos, scope of work, and invoices for your insurance adjuster
We work with most major insurance carriers
Ask us about coverage options when you call
insurance.callout: Not sure if your policy covers this? We'll help you find out.

removal.heading: How {service} Works
removal.intro: Our licensed professionals follow a thorough, documented process from assessment to completion.
bullets: On-site assessment — evaluate the full scope of work
Written quote — itemized breakdown before any work starts
Professional execution — quality workmanship with the right tools and materials
Final inspection — verify the work meets spec before we leave
Clean-up — we leave the work area clean
